# Architecture
<!-- Generated by /intel. Last updated: 2026-04-13 -->

## Stack
- **Flutter 3.7.12** via FVM (Dart >=2.17.3 <3.0.0)
- **Riverpod** (flutter_riverpod + riverpod_annotation) — hybrid old StateNotifier + new @Riverpod codegen
- **auto_route** — separate desktop (`AppRouter`) and web (`WebRouter`) routers, code-generated
- **freezed + json_serializable** — all domain models are immutable with JSON factories
- **Dio** — HTTP client, wrapped by `BaseService`
- **Hive** (web storage) / **SharedPreferences** (desktop storage)
- **process_run** — desktop CLI process spawning

## Architecture Overview

```
UI (screens/ + components/)
    ↓ ref.watch / ref.read
State (providers/ — Riverpod StateNotifier + @Riverpod)
    ↓ calls
Services (services/ — extend BaseService, Dio HTTP)
    ↓ HTTP to localhost CLI (desktop) or remote API (web)
Models (models/ — freezed, json_serializable)
```

- **Desktop**: talks to local CLI at `localhost:{7292|17292|27292}` depending on env
- **Web**: talks to `data.verifiedx.io` remote API, manages its own keypairs
- Platform branching via `kIsWeb` checks and separate router selection in `app.dart`

## Feature Structure (55 modules)
```
lib/features/{name}/
├── screens/      # Route targets (extend BaseScreen)
├── components/   # Feature widgets
├── providers/    # State (StateNotifier or @Riverpod)
├── models/       # Freezed data classes
├── services/     # API services (extend BaseService)
└── utils.dart
```

## Constraints
- All flutter/dart commands prefixed with `fvm`
- Env (mainnet/testnet/devnet) set via CLI args on desktop, `--dart-define` on web
- Storage keys prefixed by env (`release`, `release_testnet`, `web`, etc.)
- Desktop CLI lifecycle tied to app window — launched on start, killed on close
- Xcode schemes control env for macOS archive builds (Runner = mainnet, Runner-Testnet, Runner-Devnet)

## Key Entry Points
1. `lib/main.dart` — bootstrap, CLI args, singletons
2. `lib/app.dart` — root widget, router selection (web vs desktop)
3. `lib/core/providers/session_provider.dart` — desktop app state, wallet, sync
4. `lib/core/env.dart` — all environment config, API URLs, ports
5. `lib/core/services/base_service.dart` — HTTP client base class
